description: This source file contains unit tests for validating asset creation API requests in the DataAssetBackend system. The tests focus on input validation rules such as required fields, conditional dependencies, and proper error handling for invalid data submissions related to asset creation.

classes.name: AssetCreateValidationTests
classes.description: A test class that uses Xunit framework to test various scenarios of asset creation validation in the backend API.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_requiresParentPseudo_field
methods.description: Tests that the API returns BadRequest when the 'requiresParentPseudo' field is missing in the request.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_processGroupOtherText_when_processGroup_is_other
methods.description: Verifies that the API enforces the presence of 'processGroupOtherText' when 'processGroup' is set to 'Other'.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_parentPseudoAssetId_when_requiresParentPseudo_is_true
methods.description: Checks that the API requires 'parentPseudoAssetId' when 'requiresParentPseudo' is true.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_nonexistent_parentPseudoAssetId_with_400
methods.description: Ensures that the API rejects non-existent 'parentPseudoAssetId' with a 400 BadRequest response.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_parentPseudoAssetId_when_requiresParentPseudo_is_false
methods.description: Tests that providing 'parentPseudoAssetId' when 'requiresParentPseudo' is false results in a BadRequest.
